short_description: Invoice overpayment due to missing contract amendment
description: Finance processed an invoice for $12,400 against a contract capped at $10,000. The overage was not accompanied by an approved amendment. Root cause: manual invoice approval bypassed automated contract-value check.
resolution: Overpayment recovered via credit on next invoice. Amendment process now requires Procurement sign-off before Finance can release payment above contract cap.

short_description: Contract approval delayed - mandatory legal review omitted
description: A $310,000 contract was routed for CFO approval without the mandatory legal review required for contracts exceeding $250,000. Discovered during post-signature audit.
resolution: Contract sent for retroactive legal review. No material issues found, but approval workflow updated to hard-block CFO sign-off until legal review checkbox is completed in the system.

short_description: Contract missing mandatory data privacy clause discovered post-signature
description: Security audit found the executed contract with CloudServe Analytics, which processes customer data, did not include the mandatory data privacy clause required by POL-SEC-002.
resolution: Amendment executed adding the required data privacy clause. Information Security now requires a compliance checklist sign-off before any data-processing contract is approved.

short_description: Supplier name mismatch between invoice and contract
description: Invoice submitted under entity name 'Acme Logistics LLC' did not match the contracted entity 'Acme Logistics Inc.' Investigation found a related-entity billing error on the supplier's side.
resolution: Supplier corrected invoice with proper legal entity name. Finance added supplier legal-name verification as a required pre-payment check.

short_description: Advance payment approved without required written authorization
description: A 25% advance payment was released to an existing supplier (12 prior transactions) without written VP of Procurement approval, violating POL-PROC-001 Section 3.
resolution: Payment flagged, additional approval obtained retroactively. Advance payment requests now require system-enforced approval gate before release.

description: SOC 2 Type II report expired before renewal was submitted.
resolution: Updated report received; risk tier reassessment triggered per POL-VRM-005.

short_description: NDA filed with $0 value flagged by automated invoice check
description: False positive - zero-dollar invoice for recordkeeping.
resolution: No action needed; exclusion rule added for $0 NDA filings.

short_description: Legal hold placed on Vantage Point MSA records during vendor dispute review
description: A legal hold was placed on all contract and invoice records related to CTR-2026-0055 pending review of an unrelated vendor dispute. Automated retention disposal was correctly suspended for the duration of the hold per POL-DRM-006 Section 4.
resolution: Hold lifted after dispute review concluded with no findings against this contract. Standard retention schedule resumed.

description: Platform uptime fell to 98.7% in April 2026, below the 99.5% SLA commitment in Section 5 of the license agreement. Vendor initially disputed the calculation methodology.
resolution: Vendor and Company agreed on shared monitoring methodology; 6.5% service credit applied to next invoice per contract formula.
